confirmed.claim: Native v3 N1 failed in trace REPLACE with PermissionError, errno 13, winerror 5.
Two publication calls, one success; .pending and target contain identical spawn/assigned event snapshots; no final republish after failure.
confirmed.evidence: trace_publication record, trace.json/pending raw hashes, TracePublicationState

confirmed.claim: TraceAPI.pause persists on every supervisor 0.05-second polling wait, including unchanged event lists.
Observer reads trace before checking whether worker_ready exists, using Path.read_text; its RLock does not synchronize the separate controller writer.
TraceMemoryIO models serial replacement and injected exceptions, not native delete-sharing with a concurrent held reader.
Own pending stream close is attempted and no CLOSE error recorded before replacement. The published error should not be reclassified as CREATE/FileExistsError.

recommendation.scope: Draft a minimal reader/writer sharing contract before implementation; retain current protocol failure rules.
recommendation.primary_candidate: Explicit non-inheritable, read-only trace read adapter compatible with target replacement, potentially FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_WRITE|FILE_SHARE_DELETE; handles always closed and no broadened access privileges. This is a design candidate, not a proven fix.
recommendation.secondary_candidate: Short-circuit trace reads until ready/controller prerequisites exist; reduces unnecessary reads but is not the standalone repair.
recommendation.larger_alternative: Immutable versioned snapshots would avoid replacing an open target but change publication/read protocol; not selected for immediate implementation.
